title: Fleet Vehicle Authorization Form
subtitle: Fleet Vehicle Service: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Fleet Vehicle Authorization Form turns fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision into a customer-facing Fleet Vehicle Service consent record. The fleet maintenance coordinator itemizes diagnostics or services, labor, parts or materials, fees, tax, estimated total, maximum cap, and the fleet authorization contact's signed decision. Work not listed or priced remains on hold.
use_case: Use Fleet Vehicle Authorization Form at fleet yard, service facility, operating route, and vehicle assignment point. Verify applicable Fleet Vehicle Service requirements; distinguish diagnostic or inspection authority from listed work, price each operation, and record the fleet authorization contact's exact approval, conditions, or decline. Follow the selected contact-before-additional-work instruction whenever fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision scope or cost changes.
